corpus.scope: Five synthetic invoice/receipt images with independently transcribed field anchors and caller-supplied JSON Schemas.

methodology: Each case was sent as a real paid x402 V2 call to the production image endpoint. A pass required HTTP 200 with a settlement receipt, output validation against the caller-supplied JSON Schema, and an exact or explicitly normalized match for every independently transcribed anchor.
limitations: Small launch corpus; results are evidence, not a universal accuracy guarantee.
The published corpus currently covers invoices and receipts, not handwriting, severe blur, arbitrary rotation, or every supported document type.
JPEG support is contract-tested but this paid benchmark run used PNG and WebP fixtures.
